meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Forex rates, month high and month low (DBIE report 768)
meta.coverage: The month's highest and lowest rupee rates: FEDAI quotes (2000 to 2012) and reference-rate extremes
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 768. Reference-rate month highs and lows run from August 1998 to January 2024; FEDAI offer and bid extremes from 2000 to 2012. The report's third provider repeats the daily reference rate (report 575, baked as external-rupee-daily).
